THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
114
STUDY 110
Brown Hooded Knit with Lettering
Rights check
Source: 24997.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair in a high
ponytail wears a brown knit hooded sweater with cream
arched block lettering across the chest and a front
kangaroo pocket. She wears wide blue denim jeans
with a black belt and an ornate silver buckle. Her hands
rest in the pocket. Her expression is calm and direct. A
white backdrop with white cars at the sides. Palette of
chocolate, cream, and denim blue. Sporty and urban, in
the style of a street-style lookbook.
Sporty, urban, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The block lettering and wide denim are the defining
pieces.
- Describe the lettering as 'arched block lettering' to keep it
stylized.
Try this: Specify arched block lettering.
